description:
Native Model Card documenting a DynamicsModel or Policy Actor.

Fields aligned with Mitchell et al. (arXiv:1810.03993) and population
calibration provenance standards.

artifact_fingerprint.description: Canonical cryptographic SHA-256 fingerprint of the described artifact.
artifact_fingerprint.title: Artifact Fingerprint

assumptions.description: Explicit theoretical, structural, or behavioral assumptions embedded in dynamics.
assumptions.title: Assumptions

calibration_score.description: Empirical population calibration metric score (e.g. SBC/Kolmogorov score).
calibration_score.title: Calibration Score

caveats_and_recommendations.description: Actionable caveats, minimum sample guidelines, and user recommendations.
caveats_and_recommendations.title: Caveats And Recommendations

constraints_exercised.description: Identifiers of physical or operational constraints evaluated with this model.
constraints_exercised.title: Constraints Exercised

description.description: Detailed description of dynamics mechanism, architecture, or policy.
description.title: Description

ethical_considerations.description: Fairness risks, human oversight mechanisms, privacy, and systemic harm considerations.
ethical_considerations.title: Ethical Considerations

eval_data.description: Evaluation dataset, benchmark family, and split methodology.
eval_data.title: Eval Data

factors.description: Relevant operational, environmental, or demographic factors and sub-populations.
factors.title: Factors

intended_use.description: Declared organizational decisions and operating regimes model was designed for.
intended_use.title: Intended Use

limitations.description: Epistemic caveats, numerical approximations, or unmodeled feedback loops.
limitations.title: Limitations

metrics.description: Benchmark or calibration metrics (e.g. RMSE, coverage, calibration score).
metrics.title: Metrics

model_details.description: Basic details: developer, architecture, type, license, date.
model_details.title: Model Details

out_of_scope.description: Known scenarios, domains, or extreme regimes where model MUST NOT be applied.
out_of_scope.title: Out Of Scope

provenance_sources.description: Source dataset hashes, training run IDs, or empirical telemetry sources.
provenance_sources.title: Provenance Sources

quantitative_analyses.description: Distributional summaries, uncertainty intervals, and subgroup analyses.
quantitative_analyses.title: Quantitative Analyses

training_data.description: Training datasets, generator parameters, and data hashes.
training_data.title: Training Data

version.description: Semantic version string of the model.
version.title: Version

title: ModelCard
